name: Anguilla
prevalence_note: Anguilla's Financial Intelligence Unit publishes advisories, and the ECCB has warned residents of the whole currency union, Anguilla included, about unsolicited prize and investment approaches.
cross_border_note: Anguilla (+1-264) shares the NANP with the US and other Caribbean islands, so lookalike +1 numbers from elsewhere in the Eastern Caribbean or North America are hard to tell apart from local ones.

scams.name: Unsolicited prize win needing a fee
scams.name_en: ECCB-flagged prize notice asking an Anguillian to pay before collecting
scams.signals_en: A stranger announces a prize or lottery win the owner never entered and asks for a processing fee or bank details before release.
scams.legit_en: The ECCB urges residents to protect themselves against financial scams; Anguilla's FIU posts current advisories to check against.
bait_tactics: Ask which draw was entered and on what date, then keep asking for the paper confirmation
Say any fee would have to go through a branch teller in The Valley first

scams.name: Unlicensed investment offer
scams.name_en: Unlicensed high-return investment pitch flagged across the ECCU
scams.signals_en: A caller or chat contact promotes a scheme promising quick, guaranteed returns and pushes the owner to send money or recruit friends.
scams.legit_en: ECCB urges checking whether a firm is licensed before investing; licensed firms do not guarantee returns.
bait_tactics: Ask for the firm's licence number and regulator, then ask again slowly
Say the family accountant handles every investment decision
